acceptance_predicates.description: A durable WAL/SHM lifecycle record binds stable authority/control identities, journal mode, state, generation, sidecar identities when present, and a canonical digest.
Absent, active, and clean_checkpointed sidecar transitions are explicit and reject impossible or torn transitions.
Sidecar replacement, deletion while active, stable-identity drift, and lifecycle-record corruption reject closed without admitting an authority mutation.
Existing unprovisioned coordination remains usable while provisioned lifecycle corruption blocks mutation; public upgrade mutation and Dispatch remain rejection-only.

definition_of_done: Implement the smallest typed WAL/SHM lifecycle recorder and verifier under the existing owner-controlled fence.
Add hostile failure, checkpoint, replacement, corruption, and process-death/reconciliation tests with exact state evidence.
Pass independent review, hosted checks, post-merge Verify/Formal, and durable state reconciliation for one exact product revision.
The AI-generated model remains best-effort guidance; no source-to-model refinement proof or authorization prerequisite is required.
